scope: Fresh independent review of the latest formal 50-entry, 416-row packet. Every sense, explanation, exact occurrence, and actor assignment was reviewed; earlier packet verdicts were treated as superseded evidence, not inherited decisions.
keepFinding: KEEP at the packet's embedded exact entry hashes: these entries now distinguish the ordinary referent from its recorded Chan deployment, preserve genuinely different things as senses without splitting grammatical variants, and identify headword-bearing questioners or narrators instead of transferring their words to the respondent. The former defects in 木人, 師子吼, 千手眼, and 南泉斬貓 are materially repaired in this packet.

reviseFindings.finding: Actor ownership remains wrong in multiple rows. In 被馬大師一喝...黃檗聞舉不覺吐舌, Huangbo performs 吐舌, yet the C077 row assigns Mazu Daoyi. In 年吐舌曰真是龍象, the visitor 年 performs it, yet the row assigns Ciming Chuyuan; the explanation itself correctly calls him a visitor. Repair every full turn and then re-test the prose against the corrected actor set.

The first two retrospective device-list rows assign Linji Yixuan merely because the phrase names his shout; he is the person discussed, not automatically the later utterer. The Dahui-record line 德山棒如雨點，臨濟喝似雷奔 especially cannot be owned by Linji. The final long row likewise says its complete case identifies Xiangyan without displaying the speech transition that proves that ownership. Re-adjudicate later speaker/verse author versus named case figure row by row.

Three of six rows are the longer construction 踏破草鞋 (‘wear out straw sandals’). That family phrase cannot buy bare-headword depth or be silently folded into the same lexical claim under the modifier/longer-compound gate. The prose accordingly blurs discarded 破草鞋 with the different predicate 踏破. Route the longer phrase to family evidence or a separate entry, rebuild bare 破草鞋 depth, and re-check the first two actor assignments (the explanation names Huangbo and Jiashan while the stored actors name Jiashan and Yantou).

The material-gold overclaim was removed, but ‘ornate lock-barrier’ substitutes a new unproved modifier reading. Palace diction establishes the scene, not that 金 lexically means ornate. Keep the modifier visibly unresolved in the displayed target (for example a controlled ‘gold-lock barrier’ calque with clear search aliases) unless a corpus self-gloss proves ornamental force. Also remove the duplicated phrase ‘a separate sense is a binding ornate binding chain.’

The prose says Yuanwu Keqin hails the unnamed monastic with 俊哉衲子，透網金鱗, but the stored occurrence and attribution assign that clause to Baowen Hongyin. This is exactly the stale-prose defect the full-turn repair must catch. Correct the named speaker only after confirming the source turn, and re-cross-check every explanation name against the final occurrence actor.
